channel.title: IRCTC API Developer Guides & Practical Tutorials
channel.description: Production-grade walkthroughs, runnable blueprints, and developer guides for building WhatsApp train bots, Telegram vacant berth alerts, automated PNR status checks, and Python seat availability monitors on Indian Railways.

item.title: How to Build an Automated 14-Day Seat Availability Tracker in Python
item.description: Monitor Indian Railways 14-day seat availability across classes and quotas with a recurring Python daemon and instant Telegram/Discord webhook alerts when seats become available.
item.author: support@irctc.dev (IRCTC API Developer Relations)

item.title: How to Check Indian Railway PNR Status Programmatically (Node.js & Python Guide)
item.description: The definitive developer guide to querying live 10-digit PNR status, passenger manifests, berth allocations, and charting status with Node.js and Python.
item.author: support@irctc.dev (IRCTC API Developer Relations)

item.title: How to Build a Telegram Alert Bot for Vacant Berths After Chart Preparation
item.description: Learn how to monitor train chart preparation events and send instant Telegram notifications when vacant berths become available for Current Booking.
item.author: support@irctc.dev (IRCTC API Developer Relations)

item.title: How to Build a WhatsApp Train Running Status & PNR Bot in Node.js (2026 Tutorial)
item.description: Step-by-step guide to building a production-ready WhatsApp bot for live Indian Railways GPS tracking, PNR verification, and seat availability using Baileys and the irctc-api SDK.
item.author: support@irctc.dev (IRCTC API Developer Relations)
